about: At 1.25, as spotlight-rebuild.json at 1: Settings › Spotlight's Rebuild Index… (docs/adr/0051-search.mdx, decision 14) on the real search service, on a home the scenario makes, in English: the page follows the index's state (the service started at its first question, its first crawl told as it ends, never asked on a clock); Rebuild Index… asks first, and cancelled, the dialog goes and the page is as it was; confirmed, the service builds a new index from the files beside the one answering and puts it in its place, the page told as it goes and showing what the new index holds; every press Settings', exactly, and nothing else delivered.

steps.name: Spotlight, from the sidebar: the page asks the search service its preferences and follows its state (the service started at the page's first question)
the results' switches, Search Privacy… and Rebuild Index…
scrolled down to the index's buttons and its state, under the switches
the index's state, followed: the first crawl told as it ended

texts: Spotlight reads your files again from the start. Until the new index is ready, searches use the current one. This can take a while.

steps.name: cancelled: the dialog goes, the index as it was
the dialog gone, the index as it was
confirmed: the dialog goes and the service rebuilds
the dialog gone; the service builds a new index beside the one answering
rebuilt: the new index answers, the page told what it holds, Rebuild Index… available again
